title.narrative: Integrating AV for Climate-resilient Agriculture and Energy Transition in Eth.

description.narrative: Agriculture is the main source of food and income in Ethiopia. However, it is rainfed-based agriculture that is exposed to climate change. In response to the recurrent challenges of climate change, irrigation has been considered one of the main strategies to alleviate food and income shortages and enhance the livelihoods of farmers in Ethiopia. The project aims to sustainably improve smallholder farmers’ livelihood and strengthen their resilience to climate change impacts through adoption of agrivoltaics systems.
The overall objective of the project is to mobilize climate finance in order to increase the resilience of small-holder farmers in Ethiopia through Agrivoltaics
